scope: Unity Editor deterministic input through production controls and Meta locomotor, real saved scene colliders; no XR session, controller-ray click, physical Quest input or human comfort test.
checks: Exactly one Meta locomotor
Default-layer floor, walls and hatch included in collision mask
Competing sample locomotion inputs disabled
Only right controller teleport active
One EventSystem and one Meta canvas module
Controls menu has Meta ray canvas and wired resume/reset buttons
Mission console and controller grab retained
Stick drift deadzone
Diagonal movement normalized
Forward speed ~1.5 m/s; two-second distance 60 Hz=2.936, 120 Hz=2.946
Head-relative forward movement
Left stick horizontal axis strafes rather than turns
Left stick backward movement
Vertical gaze remains horizontal and finite
Held right stick turns only once, around head pivot
Recenter rearms snap turn
Teleport aiming suppresses walk and snap turn
Lost focus stops movement and requires neutral input before resuming
Menu blocks walking, turning and teleport
Closing menu does not apply held sticks
Neutral sticks restore right teleport
Front wall blocks sustained walking
Workbench blocks walking
Closed hatch blocks passage
Fully opened hatch permits exit traversal
Reset restores hatch collision
Gravity lands player while movement input is held
Releasing left stick decelerates to rest within six centimetres
